evals.description: Meridian code review package keeps core guidance, handoffs, route coverage, and context links visible.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-code-review to review a Meridian dashboard change for regressions, missing tests, and architecture drift.

evals.description: Review output keeps findings before summary with severity and file evidence.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-code-review and return findings first with severity order, file and line references, and residual risk.

evals.description: Review output reports static-only or skipped validation risk.
evals.prompt: Use $meridian-code-review to report validation gaps when review is static-only and narrow tests were not run.
